title: Smart Lighting Systems: State-of-the-Art in the Adoption of the EdgeML Computing Paradigm
content: Lighting Systems (LSs) play a fundamental role in almost every aspect of human activities. Since the advent of light, both academia and industry are engaged in raising the quality of the service offered by these systems. The advent of Light Emitting Diode (LED) lighting represented a giant step forward for such systems in terms of light quality and energy saving. To further raise the quality of the services offered by LSs, increase the range of services they offer, while at the same time consolidating their reliability and security, we see the need to explore the contribution that can derive from the use of the Artificial Intelligence of Things (AIoT) emerging technology. This paper systematically reviews and compares the state-of-the-art about the impact of the AIoT in the smart LSs domain. The study reveals that the field is relatively new, in fact the first works date back to 2019. In addition to that, the review delves into recent research works focusing on the usage of Machine Learning (ML) algorithms in an Edge-Cloud-based computing architecture. Our findings reveal that this topic is almost unexplored. Finally, the survey sheds light on future research opportunities that can overcome the current gaps, with the final aim of guiding scholars and practitioners in advancing the field of smart LSs. The study is reported in full details, so it can be replicated.
